note: Gathering's soft sounds (docs/future/13 gather:done, 'a soft sound by group', doc 17): one short CC0 take by the pack group of what was gathered, played through src/audio/keepsake-sounds.js on the tools bus, each peaked at -3 dBFS. groups maps each pack group (recipes/world pack kinds) to a sound; a group not listed is silent. sea reuses the keepsakes' wet-sand pickup. db sets each one's level; pitchCents is a small seeded spread (the gathered spot's place seeds it, so the same spot sounds the same). Sources are in assets/audio/CREDITS.md.
